claude_only.name: Within which issuer namespace and document-type scope is this invoice number guaranteed unique, and what qualifies it to global uniqueness?
Which system of record assigned this identifier, and does an authority-assigned clearance identifier exist that takes precedence?
What sequence rule governs the number series, and how are gaps, resets and per-establishment series explained?
Which internal surrogate keys exist for this document and how are they prevented from being presented as the legal invoice number?
Which governed type code classifies this document, and from which code list version is it drawn?
What obligations does this document type trigger that other types in the family do not?
Is this document a legal invoice or a non-fiscal instrument such as a proforma or request for payment, and what marks the distinction?
Is this instance an original, a copy or a duplicate, and how is that status carried across syntaxes?
Which specification identifier and process profile identifier does this instance declare?
Does the declared specification restrict, extend or exactly implement the core semantic model, and which elements are affected?
What evidence supports the conformance claim, rather than the claim being asserted without proof?
How does a receiver signal which specifications it can accept, and what happens when the declared profile is unsupported?
Which distinct dates does this document carry, and what legal effect does each one have?
Was the document issued within the statutory time limit measured from the chargeable event, and how is that assessed?
Which time zone and calendar govern a date-only business term, and how is it reconciled with instant-valued system timestamps?
How are the asserted business dates distinguished from the times at which the document was received, validated and archived?
Which party bears the legal obligation to issue this invoice, and which party actually produced it?
Where issuance is self-billed or outsourced, what agreement authorises it and how is that agreement evidenced?
How is a self-billed document marked on its face so that a receiver can identify it without inspecting agreements?
How is an issuance mandate suspended or revoked, and what happens to documents issued after revocation?
Which party roles are present on this document, and which are mandatory for its type and jurisdiction?
Which identifier schemes qualify each party identifier, and how is a bare identifier prevented from being ambiguous?
Which address and establishment details are recorded, and how do they affect tax treatment?
What electronic address is used to route the document to the buyer, and how is it distinguished from the buyer's legal identity?
How are party details on an issued document reconciled with later changes in the party master record?
How is an individual invoice line identified so that another document can reference exactly that line?
What quantity and unit of measure does the line assert, and from which code list is the unit drawn?
How is the line net amount derived from price, quantity, allowances and charges?
What line-level period and external references does the line carry, and when are they required rather than optional?
Which item identifiers are asserted for this line and which one is authoritative when they disagree?
Is the item name and description sufficient to satisfy the legal requirement to state the nature and extent of the supply?
Which classification codes are attached to the item and from which classification systems and versions?
What item attributes and origin information are carried, and which of them affect tax or regulatory treatment?
On what basis is the item price expressed, including base quantity and any gross price and discount?
What reason and reason code justifies each allowance or charge, and from which code list is the code drawn?
Which tax category and rate apply to each allowance or charge, and how does that interact with the document tax breakdown?
Where an allowance or charge is expressed as a percentage, what base amount is it applied to and is the resulting amount stated explicitly?
How are amounts grouped into tax breakdown entries, and what defines a distinct group?
Where no tax or a zero rate is applied, what reason and governed reason code justify it?
Does a reverse-charge or special regime apply, and what marking does the document carry as a result?
Is a tax representative involved, and how does that change the tax identifiers stated on the document?
In which currency are the document amounts expressed, and from which code list is the currency code drawn?
Is a separate tax accounting currency required, and what tax amount is stated in it?
What exchange rate, rate source and rate date underpin any conversion, and is that basis stated or merely assumed?
How many decimal places apply to amounts in each currency and how are half-values rounded?
Which total amounts must be stated explicitly rather than left for the receiver to compute?
How is each stated total reconciled against its constituent parts, and what tolerance is permitted?
When a rounding amount is stated, what does it represent and how is it constrained?
How does a prepaid amount interact with the amount due, and where does the evidence for the prepayment live?
By what means is payment requested, and what account, card or mandate details support that means?
When is payment due, and how is the due date derived from the terms when only terms are stated?
What remittance or payment reference must the payer quote, and how does it enable reconciliation?
Where is settlement state recorded, and what prevents it being stored as a mutable field on the issued document?
Which typed commercial references does this document carry and what is each one for?
What buyer-supplied reference is present for the buyer's own internal routing, and how does it differ from a commercial reference?
What matching is performed against these references before acceptance, and at which level does it operate?
How is a dangling or unresolvable reference detected and handled?
Which preceding document does this document amend, and how specifically and unambiguously is it identified?
Which correction mechanism is lawful in the governing jurisdiction for this document type, and why was it chosen?
What guarantees that the corrected original remains retrievable and unmodified after correction?
How is the net commercial effect of a correction chain computed across all linked documents?
What supporting objects are attached or referenced, and is each embedded or held externally?
Where a hybrid carrier holds both a visual and a structured representation, which one prevails if they disagree?
How is legibility of the human-readable form guaranteed throughout the storage period?
How is the integrity of each attachment bound to the invoice that carries it?
What is the permitted state set for this document type and which transitions are legal between them?
At which point does content become immutable, and what technical control enforces that?
Does a clearance or registration step sit between issue and delivery, and what does that change about the state model?
How is each transition recorded so that the state history can be reconstructed independently of current state?
What response kinds may a receiver return, and what does each one commit the receiver to?
How is a rejection or dispute reason coded so that the issuer can act on it without human reading?
Who within the receiving organisation is authorised to accept, reject or dispute, and how is that authority evidenced?
What effect does a dispute have on the payment due date and on retention obligations?
By which method is authenticity of origin and integrity of content assured for this document, and is that method mandatory or elective in the governing jurisdiction?
What reliable audit trail links this invoice to the underlying supply, and which documents form it?
Where a signature or seal is applied, what exact byte scope does it cover and what does it leave unprotected?
How is assurance maintained for the whole storage period as algorithms and certificates age?
Which clearance or reporting regime governs this document, and is registration a precondition of validity or a subsequent reporting duty?
What identifier, acknowledgement and signed code does the authority return, and how are they bound to the document?
Within what deadline must registration occur, measured from which event?
What happens when clearance is rejected or unavailable, and what interim status may the document hold?
Which jurisdiction's particulars apply to this document, and what determines that jurisdiction?
Which conditional particulars are triggered by this document's circumstances, such as exemption, reverse charge, margin scheme or self-billing?
Which national or sectoral usage specification applies on top of the core model, and what does it change?
In which language is the document issued, and what translation obligation applies for audit during the storage period?
Which rule sets and artefact versions were executed against this document, and which were not?
What was the outcome per rule, and how are fatal errors distinguished from warnings?
How is a document revalidated when rule sets are updated on their release cycle, and what does an old pass result mean afterwards?
What may a receiver do with a document that fails validation, and who decides?
Which syntax binding carries this instance, and which syntax versions and code-list versions does it depend on?
What semantic loss occurs when this instance is transformed into another supported syntax?
Does the instance carry extension content beyond the core semantic model, and how must a receiver treat it?
Are all calculated values explicitly present rather than left for the receiver to infer?
Which participant, document type and process identifiers address this transmission, and from which schemes are they drawn?
How was the receiver's capability and endpoint discovered, and what was the state of that lookup at send time?
What envelope wraps the business document, and what does it assert that the document itself does not?
What evidence exists that the document was delivered, and how is it distinguished from business acceptance?
What retention period applies to this document, from which trigger event is it measured, and which jurisdiction sets it?
What conditions must storage preserve for the whole period, and how is compliance monitored?
How is disposition suspended by a legal hold or dispute, and how is the suspension evidenced and lifted?
How is a personal-data erasure request reconciled with a statutory retention obligation on the same document?
What evidence is produced when disposition is finally executed?
Who owns this record, who holds it as custodian, and what does the custodian agreement permit?
Which role-scoped projections exist, and which elements does each include and exclude?
On what basis may a tax or judicial authority obtain access, and what is the response obligation?
What secondary use of invoice content is permitted to a custodian, and what is prohibited?
Which parties and systems handled this document and in what order?
Which content was generated, derived or transformed rather than authored, and from what source?
How are event times separated from observation and ingestion times where the two differ?
How would an unauthorised change to the audit trail itself be detected?

grok_only.name: What sequential invoice number uniquely identifies this invoice inside the seller's chosen series and accounting system?
Which issuing accounting or e-invoicing master system is authoritative for assigning and guaranteeing uniqueness of the invoice number?
If a Dimension UUID or ULID is assigned, how is it bound to the seller invoice number without replacing Article 226 sequential identification?
Which CORE invoice specification or CIUS does this instance claim to satisfy?
In which billing business process must the buyer process this invoice?
If a CIUS is used, which CORE optional elements were restricted out, and can a CORE-only receiver still process the instance?
Which UNCL 1001 invoice or credit-note type code and UBL document type apply, and is the instance a payment claim, credit, proforma, tax invoice or customs commercial invoice?
If the receiver has no dedicated workflow for this type code, which synonym processing path applies (typically 380 for invoices and 381 for credit notes in Peppol BIS)?
Which N1 governed-record identity, if any, is attached to this commercial document without copying retention, signature or rendition fields into this model?
Who is the seller (taxable person supplying) and who is the buyer (customer), including legal name and address as they must appear on the invoice?
Is the payee different from the seller, and if so who is entitled to receive the payable amount?
In a self-billing arrangement, which party issues the invoice, and is the required 'Self-billing' mention present?
Which parties to the transaction, agents and tax authorities may read invoice content versus header-only metadata?
Under which VAT identification numbers did the seller supply and, where required, did the buyer receive the supply?
Which electronic address scheme and endpoint identifiers should be used to route the invoice to seller and buyer?
What buyer reference or purchase-order reference is present to satisfy routing and the Peppol rule that at least one of BT-10 or BT-13 must exist?
For each line, which seller, buyer or standard item identifiers and description identify the billed good or service?
What invoiced quantity, unit of measure and unit price exclusive of tax produce the line net amount?
Which order line, contract line or receipt line does this invoice line match for three-way verification?
Which document-level and line-level allowances and charges apply, with reason codes, amounts and tax categories?
On which date was the supply made or completed, and what invoicing or delivery period bounds the claim if it differs from the issue date?
Where were the invoiced goods or services delivered, including country of origin when required for customs or tax?
Which order, sales order, contract, tender or project identifiers authenticate the billed transaction?
Which WM-ECO-024 despatch advice and receipt advice instances does this invoice cite for delivery evidence?
Which preceding invoice identifiers and issue dates does a credit note or corrected invoice reverse or replace?
On which date does VAT become accountable for seller and buyer if that date differs from the invoice issue date?
What taxable amounts, rates, category codes and tax amounts apply, including reverse charge or exemption references?
What invoice-held evidence allows a buyer or auditor to decide whether the invoice is correct from a VAT point of view?
Which ISO 4217 document currency applies, and is a separate VAT accounting currency and VAT amount in that currency required?
Do the stored totals satisfy BT-115 = BT-112 - BT-113 + BT-114 and the two-decimal amount rule?
What amount has already been paid or prepaid against this invoice, and what outstanding amount is requested?
By which date must payment be made, and which payment means and account should the debtor use?
Which WM-ECO-009 payment instances, if any, already settle part or all of this invoice's payable amount?
Has the invoice claim been assigned to a factor or other payee, and what notice must the buyer act on?
What is the current billing status of this invoice (draft, issued, sent, accepted, rejected, disputed, credited, corrected, cancelled), and when did that state occur?
If the buyer rejected or disputed the invoice, is correction done by credit note 381, negative-amount invoice 380, or corrected invoice 384, and which preceding invoice is referenced?
Was this instance already issued, and if so which fields are frozen versus represented only on a successor credit or corrected document?
Who issued, sent, approved or disputed the invoice, and what is the chain from draft to the currently effective claim?
Is this a self-billed invoice, which agreement authorises it, and has the supplier accepted or disputed it?
If this is a prepayment invoice, which final invoice will absorb the prepaid amount, or if this is a final invoice, which prepayments are deducted?
Is the invoice consolidated, consignment (non-sale), factored or freight-charge billing, and which process rules then apply?
Which semantic model and syntax binding (UBL Invoice, UBL CreditNote, UN/CEFACT CII, or another) carry this instance?
Which fatal and warning rules fired, and is the instance CORE-compliant, CIUS-compliant, or non-compliant?
Is the receiver a public entity obliged to accept EN 16931 CORE/CIUS invoices, and may it still accept a narrower national CIUS only?
Which 19 CFR 141.86 content elements are present (port, parties, description, quantities, price or value, charges, origin, assists) and which are missing?
Was the merchandise sold in transit, and are both the original export invoice and the resale invoice (or a pro forma substitute) filed?
Is this instance serving as a tax/payment invoice, a customs valuation invoice, or both, and which content profile is therefore mandatory?
Which named exporter employee is responsible for knowledge of the customs transaction?

requirements: Resolve every provider-only bundle, layer and finding against primary evidence.
Resolve the model boundary and entry kind before accepting structure.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Record every rejected and deferred node with a reason.
Do not publish while any critical conflict remains unresolved.
